reviewer.role: Independent checker only; did not implement the mechanism and did not edit shipping code or account files.
reviewer.independence: This review used only the pinned Java jar and target/release/examples/diff_one --no-oracle at the shared worktree revision 082981d14ae7cc1e177c9437f38da296f44b4031.

verdict_basis: Explicit note colors now survive in-scope attached and floating deployment notes, but the mechanism's default-style fallback claim is still false at Rust revision 082981d14ae7cc1e177c9437f38da296f44b4031. Fresh uncolored floating and attached notes with skinparam noteBackgroundColor keep Java's style-derived fills (#98FB98 and #F0FFF0) yet Rust still paints both faces with the hardcoded #FEFFDD note fill. Because omitted-color style fallback is in the account's claimed invariant and acceptance surface, these held-outs reject the mechanism.
commands: git grep -n "DefaultMemo\|FloatingMemo\|StyledNode\|deployment-note-background-color-retention" HEAD -- crates/rustuml-parser/src crates/rustuml-render/src crates/rustuml-layout/src crates/rustuml/src docs/parity-reviews || true

java: EntityImageNote uses entity.getColors().getColor(ColorType.BACK) when present and falls back to the merged note style background only when there is no explicit BACK color.
The fresh Java SVGs confirm both sides of that contract: explicit colors survive for floating and attached notes, and omitted-color notes pick up the skinparam noteBackgroundColor values.
rust: The pinned Rust deployment parser and renderer now retain explicit note.color and use deployment_note_fill(note) in the no-oracle attached and floating painters, which explains the passing explicit-color cases.
But deployment_note_fill(note) still falls back to NOTE_FILL (#FEFFDD) rather than any merged note style, so uncolored notes ignore skinparam noteBackgroundColor entirely.
prohibited_pattern_audit: A targeted git grep for the fresh note ids and mechanism name found no fixture-shaped conditionals in shipping Rust files.
The decisive failures are pure fill mismatches on otherwise matching paths, not comparator slack or post-render SVG surgery.

perturbations.finding: Rust and Java both paint the floating note MistyRose despite a Wheat noteBackgroundColor style default.
Rust and Java both honor the explicit #FFEECC attached-note background over the Wheat style default.
Java fills the note with PaleGreen from skinparam noteBackgroundColor, while Rust paints the same geometry with hardcoded #FEFFDD.
Java fills the attached note with HoneyDew from skinparam noteBackgroundColor, while Rust still paints both note faces with #FEFFDD.

findings.title: Explicit deployment note colors now survive both floating and attached forms
findings.interpretation: The model state introduced by 5954b9b1 is real and materially improves the mechanism.

findings.title: Omitted-color notes still ignore the note style background
findings.evidence: floating_inline_omitted_color_uses_style_default and attached_multiline_omitted_color_uses_style_default both fail only on fill, with Java using #98FB98 and #F0FFF0 while Rust uses #FEFFDD.
findings.interpretation: The fallback half of the claimed color precedence model is still missing.
